Presence HEIC/HEIF browser decoder third-party notices

Unmodified local CSP ESM distribution of heic-to 1.6.7.
Upstream: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
Pinned commit: 78345a3fcdb4a1d70d513fce2646aeff0127f7ba
Bundle source:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoppergee/heic-to/78345a3fcdb4a1d70d513fce2646aeff0127f7ba/dist/csp/heic-to.js
License: LGPL-3.0-or-later, full upstream text in LICENSE-heic-to.

This bundle incorporates libheif and libde265 compiled as JavaScript.
The pinned upstream release table associates 1.6.7 with libheif 1.23.7.
The upstream build instructions specify LIBDE265_VERSION=1.0.16,
USE_UNSAFE_EVAL=0, USE_WASM=0 for this CSP distribution.
libheif: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.23.7
libde265: https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/tree/v1.0.16
Both libraries: GNU LGPL version 3; the preserved upstream COPYING files
including GNU GPL/LGPL license texts are LICENSE-libheif and
LICENSE-libde265. Their original copyright notices remain in the
corresponding source archives below. Sample program/example license text
is preserved separately as LICENSE-libheif-examples.

Corresponding sources and build instructions are provided locally next to
this distribution, without any runtime dependency on third-party hosting:
  source/heic-to-78345a3.tar.gz
  source/libheif-1.23.7.tar.gz
  source/libde265-1.0.16.tar.gz
The heic-to source archive includes src/, esbuild.mjs, package-lock.json,
README build instructions, and the upstream generated libheif sources.
The other archives contain the original native library sources.

The library is loaded as a separate ESM module, not incorporated into the
application source. Users may replace heic-to.js with a compatible modified
build exposing heicTo/isHeic. Modification of the library and reverse
engineering for debugging such modifications are not restricted.

Runtime use: lazy local import; heicTo({blob:file,type:'image/png'}) returns
a Blob in the same browser. The returned pixels feed the existing crop
encoder. This build uses an in-memory blob Worker and no external WASM,
CDN, remote conversion API, photo upload, or paid API.

QA fixture provenance (not a user photograph):
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/v1.23.7/examples/example.heic
SHA256: 7f8b363e4936c0666a25f64f3a92fda10bd8e5453be4592530b65a55dd98f3f2
Size: 718114 bytes. HEIF ftyp major brand mif1, compatible heic/hevc.
The identical fixture is already in source/libheif-1.23.7.tar.gz; extract:
  tar -xOf source/libheif-1.23.7.tar.gz libheif-1.23.7/examples/example.heic > /tmp/presence-official-example.heic
No extra fixture copy is distributed outside that corresponding-source
archive. Browser QA decoded this fixture to 1280x854 PNG; visually upright
landscape town/river scene, natural blue sky and multicolored buildings.
The fixture is not an exhaustive test of all iPhone orientation/HDR modes.

Integrity hashes and exact download provenance are in manifest.json.
